answer: The hollow index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1264 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the raven. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the nebula queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 136 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
